name: react-bits
title: React Bits
responsibility: High-visual-identity website components — animated text, backgrounds, effects, landing-page components. One of the strongest sources for the actual visual design of a website.

upstream.notice: Full index (684 items) mirrored; snapshot carries ONLY the TS-TW variant (TypeScript + Tailwind, 171 items) — the variant our workspace builds on. Refresh any item: curl -sL https://reactbits.dev/r/<name>-TS-TW.json -o react-bits/r/<name>-TS-TW.json

itemShape: shadcn registry-item: { name, title, description, type, dependencies[], files[{ path, content }] }. Item names carry the variant suffix — always <Component>-TS-TW.
packagesNotice: Per-item deps are heavier here than other registries (ogl 47×, gsap 36×, three 23×). Principle §3: check the cost before pulling a WebGL-backed component for a subtle effect. Exotic one-offs (face-api.js, matter-js, vgpu, react-router-dom) stay unpinned — resolve ad hoc if a specific item needs them.
reachFor: Hero sections, animated text, animated backgrounds
Hover effects, visual effects, decorative components
Landing-page sections where the visual IS the point
avoid: Loading three.js-backed components for a subtle effect — check `packages` cost first (principle §3: no large dependency for a few nice components)
inRepo: new snapshot 2026-09-01; consumes gsap/r3f engine contracts already in this registry
